    output reg Q
);

    initial begin
        Q = 1'bX;
        #20 force D = 1'b0;
        #20 force KAPWR = 1'b0;
        #20 force NOTIFIER = 1'b0;
        #20 force SLEEP_B = 1'b0;
        #20 force VGND = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b0;

        #20 force VGND = 1'b1;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b1;
        #20 force D = 1'b0;
        #20 force KAPWR = 1'b0;
        #20 force NOTIFIER = 1'b0;
        #20 force SLEEP_B = 1'b0;
        #20 force VGND = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b1;
        #20 force VGND = 1'b1;
        #20 force SLEEP_B = 1'b1;
        #20 force NOTIFIER = 1'b1;
